covers: rtext.c's ExportFontAsCode, the header's text byte for byte: the default font, a TrueType font (LoadFontEx, the printable ASCII at 20 and five characters at 48) and a font read from an image (LoadFontFromImage, its RGBA texture written as it is): the atlas compressed as CompressData compresses it, the glyphs' rectangles and metrics, the loading function, the names from the file's name
notes: hxcpp alone: helix-ray rasterizes TrueType glyphs with the platform's native rasterizer, which Node hasn't. Each line is printed as its bytes, so a section matches only when every byte does.
